description: A client project for a luxury nail salon, designed to reflect the sophistication of the brand. The site features a high-end visual aesthetic with careful attention to typography, color, and imagery — paired with a fully responsive layout that maintains that polished feel on mobile, tablet, and desktop alike.

title: Morgan & Marston LLP
description: Morgan & Marston LLP is an attorney website built as a portfolio piece demonstrating real-world front-end development skills. The project features a two-page layout with a scrolling homepage and a dedicated contact page, built around a custom design system with a deliberate color palette, Bodoni Moda and Jost typography, and a consistent component library spanning both pages. Special attention was given to layout structure, spacing, and typographic hierarchy to achieve a refined, high-contrast aesthetic appropriate for a corporate law firm.
